ll8.info.actuallyadditions.bowl_on_water: Use your Bowl to gather from any water source
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.coffee_machin: Build a Coffee Machine, add water and Coffee Beans to its slots, place an Empty Cup and power it to brew coffee.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.crystallized: Drop Crystallized Canola Seeds into a source of Refined Canola Oil and bucket it
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.empowered: Drop Empowered Canola Seeds into a source of Crystallized Oil and bucket it
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.fill_from_pre: Run Canola through an active Canola Press and harvest the oil with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.refined_from_: Put Canola Oil in a Fermenting Barrel and let it ferment; collect the refined result with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.advanced_ae.encode_in_adv_patte: Right-click with an Advanced Pattern Encoder, place a Processing Pattern and take the result.
ll8.info.advanced_ae.fill_bucket_from_re: Power a Reaction Chamber loaded with Quantum Infused Dust and water, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.ae2.cut_with_quartz_knife: In a Cutting Knife's GUI, enter a metal ingot and type a custom name to make an Inscriber Name Press.
ll8.info.ae2.encode_in_pattern_terminal: Open ME Pattern Encoding Terminal with Blank Patterns in Smithing Table or Stonecutter mode, fill recipe and encode
ll8.info.ae2.p2p_attunement: Right-click an ME P2P Tunnel with a Chest, Torch, or Redstone Dust, then break it.
ll8.info.ae2netanalyser.loot_bundle_rand: Open a Loot bundle from FTB Quests or crafted from 9 fragments to draw 3 random items; ME Tick Profiler is rare.
ll8.info.aether.bee_queen_christmas_trad: Reach the Bee Queen in the Bumblezone on December 24-25, give her a Cookie, and attempt to gain Candy Canes.
ll8.info.aether.fill_skyroot_bucket: Right-click water or Powder Snow with a Skyroot Bucket to fill it; no other liquids are accepted.
ll8.info.aether.ftb_quest_obsidian_set: Wear Phoenix Gloves and get wet to convert them to Obsidian Gloves.
ll8.info.aether.halloween_kill_in_aether: Kill mobs in the Aether between October 21 and November 9 for a chance to drop Candy Canes.
ll8.info.aether.scoop_mob_with_skyroot_b: Trap Axolotl, Tadpole, Tropical Fish, Pufferfish, Salmon or Cod in a Skyroot Water Bucket
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_acid_radgill: Fill a Bucket with Acid from a Toxic Caves pool, then right-click a Radgill with the Bucket of Acid.
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_soda_sweetish: Right-click Sweetish Fish with a Bucket of Purple Soda from the Candy Cavity; its color determines which bucket you get.
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_water_mob: Catch Gossamer Worm, Lanternfish, Sea Pig, Trilocaris, or Tripodfish in a Water Bucket in the Abyssal Chasm.
ll8.info.alexscaves.craft_cave_map: Place a Cave Codex in the center of a 3x3 crafting grid with Paper in the eight surrounding slots.
ll8.info.alexscaves.fill_bucket_purple_s: Scoop Purple Soda from the Candy Cavity with an empty Bucket just like water.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gingerbarrel_assembl: Stock a Gingerbarrel with nine different sweets via Gingerbread Men near Gingerbread Town in Candy Cavity for armor.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gm_chicken_swab_spaw: Use Mob Swab on mob, craft GM Chicken Feed from used swab, seeds, Fluid XP Bucket; feed adult Chicken.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gummy_bear_licoroot: Feed a Gummy Bear a lasting potion to trigger hibernation, Licoroot scratching and Jelly Bean drops.
ll8.info.alexscaves.spelunkery_table_tra: Solve the Spelunkery Table's word puzzle using a Cave Tablet and Paper to receive a Cave Codex for that biome.
ll8.info.amendments.fill_bottle_from_dye: Create a dye cauldron by adding any dye to water, then extract a Dye Bottle using an empty glass bottle.
ll8.info.apotheosis.drop_from_invader_bo: Kill an Apotheosis invader boss in any dimension for a music disc (rare 5% drop).
ll8.info.apotheosis.endless_invader_gate: Clear the Apothic Pinnacle gateway for a Gate Pearl, open the Endless Gateway of Apothic Invaders, reach wave 100.
ll8.info.apothic_compats.apotheosis_affi: Loot chests in any structure to find items blessed with Apotheosis affixes from worldwide treasure rolls.
ll8.info.appmek.attune_p2p_with_chemical: Right-click an ME P2P Tunnel with a Mekanism chemical tank to convert it into a Chemical P2P Tunnel.
ll8.info.ars_additions.convert_apparatus: Sneak-click an Enchanting Apparatus with a Wixie Charm to transform it into Wixie's version.
ll8.info.ars_additions.imbue_spell_parch: Load a Spell Parchment into an Imbuement Chamber supplied with Source to create an Imbued Spell Parchment.
ll8.info.ars_additions.take_from_warp_ne: Right-click a Warp Nexus in a Nexus Tower or Arcane Library to claim its Nexus Warp Scroll.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.dungeon_chest_loo: Find a ready-made spell tome in vanilla structure chests: dungeons, temples, strongholds, mineshafts, more.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.imbue_source_gem: Place Source Gem in Imbuement Chamber with Wither Skeleton Skull, Bone Meal, and Golden Apple on Arcane Pedestals.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.ritual_of_binding: Start a Binding ritual in a Ritual Brazier near a Flarecannon, Flashjack, or Siren.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.siren_charm_on_pr: Right-click a Prismarine block with a Siren Charm to convert it into a Siren Shrine.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.capturing_drygmy_eg: Kill Drygmy yourself with weapon enchanted with Capturing; rare egg drop.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.charm_converts_bloc: Apply Wixie, Drygmy, or Whirlisprig Charms to Cauldrons, Mossy Cobblestone, or flowers respectively.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.dungeon_chest_rare_: Find this rare item in vanilla structure chests: dungeons, mineshafts, temples, strongholds, End cities, more.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.gift_starbuncle_gol: Give Gold Nugget to rare red-and-purple Starbuncle; ordinary ones give only shards.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.mob_swab_gm_chicken: Mix seeds, Mob Swab from an Alakarkinos, and experience fluid to make GM Chicken Feed, then feed it to an adult Chicken.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.quest_reward: Complete Ars Nouveau quest in FTB Quests for Annotated Codex to get Source Gems and Blank Glyph.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.ritual_of_binding_g: Summon Amethyst Golem with Charm, put Binding in Ritual Brazier within 5 blocks and start it.
ll8.info.ars_technica.enchanting_apparat: Place Wrench in Apparatus with Gold Ingot, Calibrated Precision Mechanism and Manipulation Essence on Arcane Pedestals.
ll8.info.arsdelight.serve_from_chimera_f: Cook Honey Glazed Chimera in a Cooking Pot, place it and right-click with an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.arsdelight.serve_from_wilden_sa: Right-click the placed Wilden Salad feast with a Chimera Horn for Horn Roll or a Bowl for salad.
ll8.info.arseng.attune_p2p_tunnel: Attune an ME P2P Tunnel by right-clicking it with a Source Gem or spell book to enable the matching tunnel type.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.aether_dungeon_c: Search ordinary Silver Dungeon room chests in the Aether for very rare Flamerang.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.scoop_mob_with_b: Right-click Blue Swet or Golden Swet with Bucket or Skyroot Bucket, or Slime with Skyroot Bucket only.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.valkyrie_loot_qu: Complete the Aether chapter quest for Valkyrie equipment from the Silver Dungeon to claim a Valkyrie Pickarang.
ll8.info.avaritia_integration.laser_dril: Place a laser lens in a Fluid Laser Base, power Industrial Foregoing Laser Drills at it, then right-click with a bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.cryomisi: Put Redstone Dust and Snow Block in two Solid Injectors of a powered Fluidizer to make Cryomisi, then collect in tank.
ll8.info.bigreactors.fluidizer_melt_ingo: Melt a Yellorium, Cyanite, Blutonium, or Magentite Ingot in a Fluidizer, pipe the fluid to a tank, and fill buckets.
ll8.info.bigreactors.reactor_waste_from_: Burn Verderium; a Reactor Fuel Injection Port (Reinforced) in Outlet Mode sends Rossinite to a tank.
ll8.info.bigreactors.redfrigium: Supply Cryomisi and Tangerium to a powered Fluidizer's injectors to produce Redfrigium, pipe to tank, fill a bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.tangerium: Place Anglesite and Ender Pearls in separate Injectors of a powered Fluidizer to make Tangerium, then collect in tank.
ll8.info.bigreactors.verderium: Mix Yellorium and Blutonium Ingots in separate Injectors of a powered Fluidizer to make Verderium, then gather in tank.
ll8.info.brewinandchewin.serve_from_plac: Place a cooked Fiery Fondue pot and collect a serving with a bowl by right-clicking it.
ll8.info.buildinggadgets2.save_in_templa: Combine a Copy-Paste Gadget holding a structure and paper in a Template Manager to save it as a reusable Template.
ll8.info.butchercraft.chicken: Right-click a chicken with a Butcher Knife; use Glass Bottle, Shears then Gutting Knife on a Butcher Block.
ll8.info.butchercraft.livestock: Right-click cow, pig, sheep or goat with Butcher Knife; hang carcass on Meat Hook; use Bucket, Skinning Knife, Bone Saw.
ll8.info.butchercraft.place_skull_from_c: Work a Cow Head on a Butcher Block with a Gut Knife four times to harvest its skull.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_baby_lev: Defeat The Leviathan, hatch the Abyssal Egg, feed the Baby Leviathan Tropical Fish, then scoop it with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_modern_r: Kill an Ancient Remnant for Skull, summon a Modern Remnant with it, feed it a Sniffer Egg, then collect in a Bucket.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_netherit: Craft a Netherite Effigy, summon a Netherite Ministrosity with it, feed it a Lava Power Cell, then collect in a Bucket.
ll8.info.chemlib.bucket_from_liquifier: Build a Chemical Liquifier, feed ChemLib chemical items with FE, then right-click with an Empty Bucket.
ll8.info.chemlib.mine_with_ie_excavator: Find a Bituminous Coal vein with a Core Sample Drill and run a powered Excavator over it to dig Phosphorus Dust.
ll8.info.chemlib.press_plate_in_ie_metal: Feed Cobalt, Osmium or Zinc Ingots into a powered Immersive Engineering Metal Press with Metal Press Mold: Plate.
ll8.info.chickens.boss_drop_skin_crate: Strike down Ender Dragons, Withers, Wardens, or Elder Guardians for rare skin crate rewards.
ll8.info.chickens.catch_with_catcher: Use a Chicken Catcher on an adult Chicken to capture it without losing its breed or stats.
ll8.info.chickens.chemical_chicken_lays_: Breed a chemical Chicken in a Chicken Breeder, then collect Chemical Eggs it lays or place the Chicken in a Roost.
ll8.info.chickens.chicken_dies_in_lava: Let lava kill a vanilla Chicken for a 50% chance of Lava Chicken.
ll8.info.chickens.douse_chicken_for_spaw: Use an Avian Dousing Machine to turn a Chicken into a Spawn Egg.
ll8.info.chickens.fluid_chicken_lays_egg: Breed a Water Chicken in a Chicken Breeder to collect Liquid Eggs, or place it in a Roost.
ll8.info.chickens.loot_bundle_random_pic: Obtain Loot bundles from mob drops or trial chambers; opening them has a tiny chance to yield a rare Gas Egg.
ll8.info.chickens.robot_upgrade_and_viru: Find a Smart Chicken and right-click it repeatedly with roost upgrades.
ll8.info.chickens.tame_then_catch_mega_c: Tame a wild Mega Chicken with seeds, then capture with Chicken Catcher when riderless.
ll8.info.chipped.alchemy_bench: Choose a variant for diamond, gold, emerald, amethyst or other minerals at an Alchemy Bench.
ll8.info.chipped.botanist_workbench: Customize dirt, sand, ice, leaves, pumpkin or mushroom blocks at a Botanist Workbench.
ll8.info.chipped.carpenters_table: Select your desired variant in a Carpenters Table by placing wood materials inside.
ll8.info.chipped.glassblower: Select a shape and feed glass, stained glass, or glass panes into the Glassblower to craft it.
ll8.info.chipped.loom_table: Place wool or carpet in the Loom Table to create different variants.
ll8.info.chipped.mason_table: Use a Mason Table with any stone-type block to create the variant you want.
ll8.info.chipped.tinkering_table: Craft a Tinkering Table. Put blocks into it to select their variants.
ll8.info.cobblemon.drop_from_defeated_po: Defeat a wild Pokémon of the correct species for a 2.5-25% chance to obtain this drop.
ll8.info.cobblemon.evolve_shelmet_with_l: Right-click your Shelmet with Link Cable (Karrablast in party) to evolve it to Accelgor and drop Shell Helmet.
ll8.info.cobblemon.slather_saccharine_lo: Coat a Saccharine Log by right-clicking its side with a Honey Bottle; break it to retrieve the plain log.
ll8.info.cobblemon.snorlax_drop_or_eat_a: Defeat Snorlax, Munchlax, Garbodor, or Trubbish for 5–2.5% drop, or eat apples for 2.5%.
ll8.info.crabbersdelight.bucket_crab: Catch a Crabber's Delight Crab with a Water Bucket by right-clicking it.
ll8.info.crabbersdelight.coconut_falls_o: Stand under hanging Coconut with no helmet; break the block above or hit it with projectile to make it fall on you.
ll8.info.create.convert_contact_by_eleva: Put Redstone Contacts on the shaft wall facing the cabin's contact and assemble the elevator to make Elevator Contacts.
ll8.info.create.encase_with_casing: Right-click a Shaft, Cogwheel or Large Cogwheel with Andesite or Brass Casing.
ll8.info.create.shop_table_cloth: Price a Table Cloth, link it to a Stock Ticker with a Stock Keeper, then right-click the Table Cloth with an empty hand.
ll8.info.create.wrench_pickup_chest_cart: Build a structure on a powered Cart Assembler, send a Minecart with Chest through it, then pick it up with a Wrench.
ll8.info.create_connected.creeper_killed: Let a Skeleton kill a Creeper with an arrow to drop a random Music Disc from the Creeper loot table.
ll8.info.create_connected.encase_with_ca: Place a Cross Connector, then right-click it while holding an Andesite or Brass Casing.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.fil: Feed Experience Nuggets into an Item Drain with a Mechanical Grindstone on top; then fill buckets from a tank.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.inf: Pour Infused Dragon's Breath into an Item Drain, pipe the fluid into a Fluid Tank and fill a bucket.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.mix: Use a Mechanical Mixer over a Basin to process Apotheosis materials into Apotheotic Essence, then collect with a Bucket.
Put Apotheosis Gem Dust in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer to turn it into Crystal Essence, then fill a Bucket with it.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.pla: Right-click an Item Drain with a Mechanical Grindstone to turn it into a Grindstone Drain.
ll8.info.create_mechanical_chicken.fill_: Get Chicken Nutrient fluid by combining any seeds with water in a Basin with a Mechanical Mixer.
ll8.info.createaddition.bioethanol: Use a Mechanical Mixer above a Basin to process Sugar, Cinder Flour, and 2 Biomass; capture the 1000 mB in a Bucket.
ll8.info.createaddition.seed_oil: Press any seeds in a Basin under a Mechanical Press, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.createcasing.apply_casing: Apply a Casing to Shafts, large Cogwheels, Cogwheels and Fluid Pipes by right-clicking while holding it.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.distill_: Pump Crude Oil into a heated Distillation Tower to make Diesel or Gasoline, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.ferment_: Put food with bone meal in a Basin with a Basin Lid to ferment Ethanol, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.mix_conc: Concrete Powder and water in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer produce Cement; collect it in a bucket from a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.mix_oil_: Plant Oil and Ethanol in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer yield Biodiesel; collect it in a bucket from a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.press_se: Seeds in a Basin under a Mechanical Press yield Plant Oil; collect it in a bucket from a Spout.
ll8.info.crittersandcompanions.bucket_wa: Catch Dumbo Octopus, Koi Fish and Sea Bunny from water using a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.bucket_aerglow_fish: Catch an Aerglow Fish in Aether water using a Water Bucket or Skyroot Water Bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.bucket_quicksand: Collect Virulent Quicksand from a Yagroot Swamp using an empty Bucket or Skyroot Bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.craft_aerwhale_sadd: Craft Aerwhale Saddle on a crafting table: 3 Leather, 2 Stratus Ingot, 1 Sun Core.
ll8.info.deep_aether.dungeon_reward_ches: Open the reward chest after defeating an Aether dungeon boss.
ll8.info.deep_aether.fish_in_aether: Fish in Aether waters with a regular Fishing Rod for a rare disc.
ll8.info.deep_aether.flawless_boss_drop: Kill the Slider or Eye of the Storm without taking any unblocked hits.
ll8.info.deep_aether.halloween_slider_dr: Defeat the Slider when Deep Aether's Halloween season is active, around October.
ll8.info.deep_aether.shovel_golden_grass: Right-click a Golden Grass Block in the Golden Heights with a shovel to form a path, then break it for Aether Dirt.
ll8.info.deeperdarker.dye_in_crafting_gr: Combine a Sculk Transmitter with any dye in your inventory grid to craft its dyed variant
ll8.info.displaydelight.place_the_food: Place food on a Food Plate by right-clicking with food in hand, then mine with Silk Touch.
ll8.info.divinerpg.catch_fish_with_water: Right-click the Cauldron Fish with a Water Bucket to catch it.
ll8.info.divinerpg.fill_bucket_from_tar_: Fill an empty Bucket with Smoldering Tar from source blocks in dry biomes, DivineRPG dimensions, Mortum or Dune Valley.
ll8.info.divinerpg.light_the_portal: These are portal dimensions; build the matching frame and light it with the correct item.
ll8.info.divinerpg.throw_item_into_fire: Drop the right material on burning fire blocks to convert them into colored flames.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_arcana_merchant: Find an Arcana merchant in the dungeon, open its cage with a pick or the right crop, then trade.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_iceika_groglin: Trade Olivine with Groglin villagers in the Iceika Groglin village.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_iceika_tinkerer: At Iceika workshops, the Workshop Tinkerer freezes your weapon when you bring a Snowflake
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_jack_o_man: Find Jack o'Man in Overworld forests; trade Wither Skeleton Skulls for armor or Bones and Ender Pearls for the Scythe.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_vethea_hunger: Seek The Hunger in Vethea's bottom-layer ceiling huts; trade Ender Pearls and Rock Chunks for Dream tools and rare gear.
ll8.info.dndesires.spout_fill_bucket: Mix a milkshake in a Create basin under a Mixer, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_fetch_returns_: Throw a Frisbee to your tamed dog with right-click and it will return as a Drool Frisbee
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_wearing_bunny_: Equip your dog with Bunny Ears and it gains a 15% chance to drop Easter Egg Candy per mob kill.
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_wearing_wig_ki: Apply a Chopin Wig to your dog via right-click; 15% of its kills yield a Chopin Music Disc
ll8.info.doggytalents.sniffer_dog_return: Craft a Scent Treat, right-click a block to sample its scent, then right-click a Sniffer Dog.
ll8.info.doggytalents.unpod_edamame: Burst Edamame by right-clicking in the air to get 2-3 Unpodded Edamame, or use a Rice Mill to process in bulk.
ll8.info.draconicevolution.bind_unbound_: Right-click in the air holding an Un-Bound Dislocator to bind it.
ll8.info.draconicevolution.reaper_kill_d: Enchant a sword with Reaper and slay mobs to get Souls - roughly 1 per 1000 hostiles or 800 animals at Reaper I
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.hit_silverfish_: Attack a Silverfish with Amethyst Rock Candy to get a Candied Silverfish Sucker.
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.serve_from_feas: Use a Bowl on a feast block cooked in the Monster Pot to extract one serving.
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.slice_pizza_wit: Get slices from a Polterghast Pizza: place it first, then right-click with any knife.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.capture_teacup_pig: Right-click a Teacup Pig with a Flower Pot to capture it as a Teacup Pig Pot.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.capture_tiny_tropi: Right-click a tiny Tropical Slime with Water Bucket to capture it as Tropical Slime Bucket.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.horned_sheep_rams_: Provoke a Horned Sheep to charge at you in front of Stone, Packed Ice, or logs to earn a Sheep Horn Flute.
ll8.info.enderio.coordinate_selector_wit: Hold Ender IO Coordinate Selector and paper, then right-click a block to save its coordinates.
ll8.info.enderio.fill_from_vat: Add reagents to Ender IO Vat with water, wait for fermentation, then right-click with empty Bucket to harvest.
ll8.info.enderio.fill_from_xp_tank: Pipe XP Juice from an XP Vacuum or XP Obelisk into a Fluid Tank and collect it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.enderio.mystical_silicon_essenc: Grow Silicon Seeds and craft 3 Silicon Essence in a row to get silicon.
ll8.info.endersdelight.serve_from_stuffe: Take a serving from a Stuffed Shulker feast block using a Shulker Bowl by right-clicking.
ll8.info.energizedpower.fill_dirty_water: Fill Advanced Crusher with water, run recipes to make Dirty Water, pipe to Fluid Filler with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.energizedpower.fill_liquid_xp_i: Put an XP Drain on a Fluid Tank, pipe Liquid XP into a powered Fluid Filler holding an empty Bucket to collect it.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.awaken_enig: Right-click the dormant Enigmatic Eye from your first opened chest to awaken it into an Inscrutable Eye.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.charge_core: In your inventory, right-click a Starlight Pearl onto an Etherium Core to charge it into a Starlight Core.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.drop_on_dea: Die wearing the Ring of the Seven Curses to drop a Soul Crystal containing lost health.
Equip an Enigmatic Amulet in its curio slot before death to preserve your drops in an Extradimensional Vessel.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.end_city_ch: Wear the Ring of the Seven Curses and loot End City treasure chests in the End for an Enchanted Celestial Fruit.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.first_ichor: Unlock your first Overworld loot chest that holds a Nectar of Ichor to get its Enchanted version.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.nether_ches: Deal damage to mobs in the Nether while at low health; the Charm appears in the next loot chest you open there.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.purificatio: Brew Honey Bottle with Pure Heart in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.quest_rewar: Complete the optional ring-marked quest in FTB Quests' Adventure chapter to get the Ring of the Seven Curses.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.twisted: Brew Awkward Potion with Eye of Ender, then brew the result with Twisted Heart in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.use_bless_s: Hold the Holy Stone in hand; right-click in Hardcore or die elsewhere to transform the Ring of the Seven Curses.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.wormhole: Brew Awkward Potion with Eye of Ender, then brew the result with Fermented Spider Eye in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.boss_dies_wit: Don't damage an Eternal Starlight boss; let other mobs kill it to get a Loot Bag instead of a Loot Chest.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.break_leaves_: In Eternal Starlight, harvest leaf blocks to rarely find a Blossom of Stars.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.bucket_the_fi: Use a Water Bucket to capture a Luminaris, Luminofish or Rookfish swimming in Eternal Starlight waters.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.drop_while_fi: Hit mobs in melee with Mana Crystal to rarely drop Shards; use hopper to collect.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.drown_a_rookf: Suffocate a Rookfish on land to obtain the Brisk Music Disc.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.fill_bucket_w: Fill an empty Bucket with Ether from a source block in the Ether River biome.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.ignite_stella: Right-click Stellagmite with flint and steel, fire charge, blaze rod, or Thermal Springstone Ingot.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.mine_with_res: Craft a Resonance Enchanted Book at Pastel's Enchanter, enchant a pickaxe, mine Budding Thioquartz in geodes.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.moth_kills_gl: Tame Crystallized Moth and let it kill Gleech for a rare Music Disc drop.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.ram_deer_into: Provoke an Aurora Deer to charge into a log behind you to make it drop antlers.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_accesso: Drop an Eternal Starlight accessory into Ether to transform it into Butterfly Wings Amulet.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_disc_in: Toss any music disc into Ether to receive Spirit or Ether Rain Music Disc.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_shatter: Right-click a Shattered Sword with its blade to throw the blade like a trident.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.till_or_flatt: Right-click Nightfall Dirt with a hoe for farmland or a shovel for a path.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.trade_with_bo: Boarwarf Silversmith cannot be encountered in Eternal Starlight 0.9.0 survival mode.
ll8.info.evilcraft.chest_loot_broom: Assemble a Rod, Brush and Cap Broom Part in your crafting grid to make a complete Broom.
ll8.info.evilcraft.chest_loot_condensed_: Find Condensed Blood in village, dungeon, Nether fortress and ancient city treasure chests.
ll8.info.evilcraft.fill_bucket_from_tank: Right-click a Dark Tank with 1000+ mB of Blood while holding an empty bucket to fill it, or scoop a Blood source block.
ll8.info.evilcraft.spirit_portal_book_or: Give an animal a Darkened Apple to infect it, wait for death and throw a Book into the Spirit Portal.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.blas: Melt Blaze Powder in an Electric Blast Furnace and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.cann: Load food and a Tin Can into a Canning Machine to produce Canned Food.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.cat_: Drop a Nano Helmet next to a tamed cat to get a Nyano Helmet.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.chem: Pour Potassium Hydroxide, Phosphoric Acid and Nitrogen into a Chemical Reactor, then bucket NPK from output.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.comp: Add 150 mB Manure, 1 Bone Meal and 1 Mulch to any Extended Industrialization Composter; click output with empty bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.dist: Distill water in a Distillery and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.hone: Place Steel Honey Extractor facing a beehive or melt Honey Block in Electric Blast Furnace; empty bucket on outlet.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.reac: Combine Bone Meal with Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor to make Phosphoric Acid, then bucket it from output.
Put water, Hydrochloric Acid, and Granite Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click its fluid output slot with an empty bucket.
Feed Potassium Chloride, Hydrogen and Oxygen into a Chemical Reactor and bucket out the Potassium Hydroxide.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.wast: Place a Waste Collector under animals and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
ll8.info.extendedae.pack_device_with_tap: Right-click any ME Interface, Pattern Provider, or Drive with ME Packing Tape.
ll8.info.extradelight.separate_egg_in_mi: Right-click a Mixing Bowl while holding an egg to separate it into Egg White and Egg Yolk.
ll8.info.farmersdelight.serving_from_fea: Hold an empty Bowl and right-click the feast block to claim a single serving of the dish inside.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.brush_ocean_ruin_: Apply a Brush to Suspicious Sand or Suspicious Gravel blocks in ocean ruins.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.bucket_live_fish: Right-click a Fish of Thieves fish in water while holding a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.eat_pineapple: Hold right-click to eat a Pineapple; you get a Half Pineapple when finished.
ll8.info.forbidden_arcanus.boss_catcher: Put a Quantum Catcher in a tier 4 Hephaestus Forge, the rest on pedestals; right-click with a Blacksmith Gavel.
ll8.info.forbidden_arcanus.whirlwind_pri: Put White Wool in a tier 3 Hephaestus Forge, Elementarium as its enhancer; right-click with a Blacksmith Gavel.
ll8.info.framedblocks.encode_in_framing_: Use a Framing Saw's AE2 tab to encode Blank Patterns, then place them in Pattern Provider beside Powered Framing Saw.
ll8.info.frightsdelight.lollipop_mold_ha: Place a Lollipop Mold, right-click it 4 times with Bone Shards, add a syrup bottle, and collect lollipops when hardened.
ll8.info.frightsdelight.ring_candy_mold_: Fill a prepared Ring Candy Mold with syrup and wait 45 seconds to collect the ring candies.
ll8.info.gag.lightning_strikes_dropped_h: Strike a dropped Hearthstone with lightning during a thunderstorm using a Lightning Rod or Trident with Channeling.
ll8.info.georenouveau.awaken_budding_geo: Kill the GeOre Golem raised by an Awakening ritual and Ritual Brazier next to a Budding GeOre.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.brew_protein: Brew Protein by placing Honey Bottle on top and Banana traps below in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.buy_from_wander: Trade 3 Emeralds to a Wandering Trader to buy a Banana trap.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.capture_steve_i: Right-click a Grotesque steve with a Magic capsule to catch it.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.fill_bucket_wit: Get swallowed by a Grotesque steve and collect Bbb from the stomach pools with a bucket.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.find_mysterybox: Find a Mystery box in the Grotesque Mansion, or rename a Grotesque Steve to 'Mystery' and kill him.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.given_on_first_: You receive it automatically when you first log into a world with this mod.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.kill_grotesque_: Right-click a Grotesque steve with Protein to transform into Grotesque prime boss; kill it.
Find a Grotesque Steve mound in plains, forest, birch forest, taiga or savanna and kill it.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.loot_bundle_ran: Obtain a Loot bundle from FTB Quests and use it to randomly draw 3 items.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.loot_mansion_co: Defeat a Grotesque steve and raid the mansion: get the Scroll from an upper Chest and the Coder laptop from a Barrel.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.open_mailbox: Right-click a Mail box to burst it and receive three random items from the gift pool.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.open_mysterybox: Right-click a Mystery box to open it and receive three random Magnets or Bubble movers.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.take_bust_from_: Right-click the Prime Statue that forms after killing Grotesque Prime to get the Prime statue bust.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_dried_green: Craft Dried Green Tea Leaf Block from Dried Green Tea and place it; it slowly turns into Black Tea Leaf Block.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_green: Craft Green Tea Leaf Block and place it; it slowly dries into Dried Green Tea Leaf Block.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_mixed: Craft Mixed Tea Leaf Block from Dried Green and Black Tea and place it; it slowly turns into Oolong Tea Leaf Block.
ll8.info.ic2cre.ash_from_solid_fuel_fire: Burn furnace fuel in a Solid Fuel Firebox and collect the Ashes it sometimes leaves behind.
ll8.info.ic2cre.bake_coal_in_coke_kiln: Build a Coke Kiln multiblock from Refractory Bricks and drop Coal into the top hatch to bake it.
ll8.info.ic2cre.break_crop_for_seed_bag: Break a grown plant on Crop Sticks to get a Crop Seed Bag with its genes and stats.
ll8.info.ic2cre.fill_bucket_in_fluid_can: Put fluid in a Fluid Canner, empty Bucket in fill slot, power it; filled Bucket comes out of output slot.
ll8.info.ic2cre.harvest_crossbred_crop: Cross two grown crops with a Crop Stick between them, then right-click to harvest the hybrid.
ll8.info.ic2cre.liquid_heat_exchanger_co: Supply Water or Lava to Liquid Heat Exchanger's hot inlet; catch result in cold inlet with Bucket.
ll8.info.ic2cre.reactor_hot_coolant_slot: Build a 5x5x5 Reactor Pressure Vessel shell around the Nuclear Reactor, then load coolant and buckets.
ll8.info.ic2cre.solar_distiller_output_s: Set a Solar Distiller under open sky, add a Water Bucket to input and an empty Bucket to output; daylight distils water.
ll8.info.ic2cre.tap_booze_barrel_with_mu: Right-click a Booze Barrel with a Treetap to tap it, then use a Stone Mug to collect the brew.
ll8.info.iceandfire.capture_dragon_with_: Craft Dragon Horn, tame a Fire or Ice Dragon, right-click your tamed dragon with the empty Horn to capture it.
ll8.info.iceandfire.catch_pixie_in_jar: Right-click wild Pixie in forest or jungle biomes with Jar; Pixie is trapped and Jar takes its color.
ll8.info.iceandfire.kill_troll_for_weapo: Kill a Troll to get its weapon.
ll8.info.iceandfire.silk_touch_stone_sta: Mine Stone Statue blocks with a Silk Touch pickaxe; they shatter on the tenth hit.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.acetaldehy: Refine Ethanol with Silver Plate or Petroleum Gas with Constantan Plate in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.biodiesel: Refine Plant Oil and Ethanol with Nitrate Dust in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.circuit_ta: Power the Engineer's Circuit Workbench, load Backplane, Vacuum Tube, and Copper Wire, select operator in the GUI.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.creosote: Char coal in a Coke Oven to produce Creosote Oil; right-click a tank or the machine's bucket slot with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.ethanol: Collect Ethanol with an empty bucket from a tank or barrel piped from an Industrial Fermenter loaded with crops.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.fill_potio: Collect brewed potion from a Fluid Tank with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.herbicide: Collect Herbicide from a Fluid Tank with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.high_cetan: Brew liquid Strength potion in Mixer, mix with Biodiesel in Refinery, pipe to Fluid Tank, and collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.outfitter_: Trade with Outfitter for Emeralds, or craft one bag of the next rarity level into two of this rarity.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.phenolic_r: Use an empty bucket on a tank to harvest Phenolic Resin made from Acetaldehyde and Creosote Oil in a Refinery.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.plantoil: Collect Plant Oil with an empty bucket from a tank or barrel piped from an Industrial Squeezer running seeds.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.benzol: Distill Kerosene in the Distillation Tower to produce Benzol; pipe to a Fluid Tank and collect with a Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.crusher_petc: Crush Petcoke or Petcoke Blocks in the Immersive Engineering Crusher.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.distillation: Distill Crude Oil in Distillation Tower; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.fill_from_ta: Collect Crude Oil from a tank fed by a Pumpjack over an oil deposit.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.gasoline: Refine Naphtha and Benzol in the Refinery; pipe to a Fluid Tank and collect with a Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.hydrotreater: Process Sulfurized Diesel and Water in High-Pressure Refinery Unit, pipe Diesel to Fluid Tank, collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.light_with_f: Ignite a Molotov by right-clicking for one second while holding Flint and Steel in your off-hand.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.napalm: Mix Gasoline with Aluminum Dust in the Mixer and collect Napalm from the Fluid Tank in a Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.petroleum_ga: Produce Petroleum Gas from Naphtha and Water in a High-Pressure Refinery Unit, collect from a Fluid Tank with a Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.seismic_surv: Place Seismic Survey Tool, right-click it with Buckshot to load, then right-click it again with empty hand.
ll8.info.industrialforegoing.fill_bucket: Insert an empty Bucket into a working Industrial Foregoing machine's tank slot to harvest its output fluid.
ll8.info.industrialforegoing.ore_meat_ch: Feed raw ore and Liquid Meat to the Washing Factory to get Raw Ore Meat, then ferment it in the Fermentation Station.
ll8.info.integrateddynamics.fill_bucket_: Power Mechanical Squeezer with FE, squeeze Menril Log into Menril Resin, right-click it with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.integrateddynamics.liquid_choru: Power the Mechanical Squeezer on Popped Chorus Fruit for Liquid Chorus, collect with Bucket when 1000 mB accumulates.
ll8.info.ironfurnaces.explode_million_fu: Build a Million Furnace, then trigger an explosion to get Rainbow Coal.
ll8.info.irons_jewelry.chest_loot_and_je: Hunt through dungeon and structure chests for them, or trade with a Jeweler villager and Wandering Trader for emeralds.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.energized_core: Summon the Rod o' Lightning by right-clicking a Lightning Rod during a thunderstorm, holding an Energized Core.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.kill_magehunte: Slay Magehunter Vindicators at Evoker Forts for a rare chance at their Sharpness V Magehunter weapon.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.kill_necromanc: Kill Necromancer at night anywhere or in Catacombs for Tarnished Crown (15% chance, raised by Looting).
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.take_lectern_b: Take Archevoker's Logbook from lectern in Evoker Fort or Unchained Book from Pyromancer Tower cellar.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_cryomanc: Trade 4 Fire Ale from Pyromancer Tower to a Cryomancer in Mountain Tower for Whispers of Ice disc.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_fort_mag: Pay 64 Emeralds to translate an untranslated Archevoker's Logbook via the Wandering Trader in an Evoker Fort.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_priest_o: Give the translated Archevoker's Logbook to a Priest, or 64 Emeralds and a Book and Quill to a nitwit in an Evoker Fort.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_wanderin: Find a Wandering Trader with the rare offer: 1 Hither-Thither Wand for 112-128 Emeralds.
ll8.info.justdirethings.blaze_ember: Throw Blaze Ember into Polymorphic Fluid source (level 0) and scoop with a Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.eclipse_ember: Throw Eclipse Ember into Voidflame Fuel source (level 0) and scoop with a Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.fill_from_experi: Feed an Experience Holder with XP via GUI or Collect mode, then bucket the resulting XP Fluid.
ll8.info.justdirethings.goo_converts_bud: Place Shadowpulse Goo next to Budding Amethyst or Time Crystal Block, revive with Sculk and wait 4 minutes.
ll8.info.justdirethings.polymorphic: Throw Polymorphic Catalyst into a water source and scoop the Polymorphic Fluid with a Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.t2: Revive Blazebloom Goo with Blaze Powder or Nether Wart at Unrefined Blaze Ember Fuel; after 2 minutes, bucket it.
ll8.info.justdirethings.t3: Revive VoidShimmer Goo on Unrefined Voidflame Fuel with Ender Pearl or Chorus Fruit; after 2 minutes scoop with Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.t4: Enliven Shadowpulse Goo with Sculk or Sculk Catalyst at Unrefined Eclipse Ember Fuel; after 2 minutes, bucket it.
ll8.info.justdirethings.till_dirt_eclips: Right-click dirt with Eclipse Alloy Hoe to turn it into Shadowpulse Soil.
ll8.info.justdirethings.unstable_portal: Throw Portal Fluid Catalyst into Polymorphic Fluid source and scoop the Unstable Portal Fluid with a Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.voidflame: Throw Voidflame Coal into Blaze Ember Fuel source (level 0) and scoop with a Bucket.
ll8.info.livingthings.bucket_seahorse: Catch a Seahorse by right-clicking it underwater with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.livingthings.drop_from_ancient_: Kill an Ancient Blaze to get its helmet.
ll8.info.livingthings.take_from_ostrich_: Breed ostriches until a nest appears with an egg; extract it by right-clicking the nest with an empty hand.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.block_with_strength: Strengthen a Shield, gain Immunity/Damage Exchange, wear 15+ armor, collect souls, then block a hit.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.blood_circle_on_clo: Place Spell Cloth, wound yourself with Dagger, press M, right-click the circle with three powders, break it.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.bucket_the_lake: Draw Power Consolidation circle (2x Powdered Diamond, Powdered Emerald) to spawn Murky Water; bucket a source.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.kill_pet_with_calib: Hold Caliburn and kill your tamed Wolf to transform the sword into Morgan.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.lightning_on_streng: Get Emrys by standing in lightning while holding a Scroll-strengthened Stick in hotbar slot 1 or off-hand.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.longshot_with_stren: Strengthen a Bow with a Scroll, then shoot a target at least 200 blocks away.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.strengthened_book_o: Set a Scroll-strengthened Written Book on an empty Lectern; with positive writing, it becomes William.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.strengthened_sword_: Strengthen a Sword with Scroll of Strengthening, stand in dragon breath in the End, right-click.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.throw_sword_in_lake: Grow a full Murky Water lake with Power Consolidation, then throw an enchanted sword in to create Caliburn.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.use_scroll_to_summo: Use a scroll with enough mana to summon its weapon; Rule Breaker needs 2+ Probability Alter circles with Chorus Fruits.
ll8.info.malum.soul_binding_brazier: Activate a Soulbinding Brazier with Ether after filling it with recipe items, then sacrifice demanded creatures.
ll8.info.malum.thrown_weapon_placeholder: Hold a Rebound-enchanted scythe or the Sundering Anchor and right-click to throw it.
ll8.info.malum.weeping_well_rejection: Jump into a Weeping Well's Primordial Soup pool to be ejected and collect Umbral Spirits (once per player).
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_ghost: Right-click a Ghost to cycle through Happy Ghost, Haunting Ghost, and back to plain Ghost.
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_sleeping_bat: Place a Sleeping Bat and right-click it to get the Awakened Bat.
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_stocking_pai: Place a single stocking of the same colour, then right-click it with an empty hand to turn it into a pair.
ll8.info.mekanism.electric_pump_filter: Power an Electric Pump with a Filter Upgrade over water and place a Bucket in its container to extract Heavy Water.
ll8.info.mekanism.nutritional_liquifier: Put food and empty Bucket in powered Nutritional Liquifier to get Nutritional Paste Bucket.
ll8.info.mekanism.rotary_condense_to_buc: Feed a chemical to a running Rotary Condensentrator; the top fluid input slot accepts an empty Bucket for extraction.
ll8.info.mekanism.thermal_evaporation_pl: Build a Thermal Evaporation Plant and fill with water; extract brine with an empty Bucket from controller output.
ll8.info.mekanismgenerators.fill_from_ro: Make Deuterium, Tritium, or D-T Fuel and feed into powered Rotary Condensentrator, put Bucket in top right slot.
ll8.info.minecolonies.bee_queen_christma: Dec 24-25 (real date), give the Bee Queen in the Bumblezone Cookies for a rare Santa Hat reward.
ll8.info.minecolonies.blacksmith_assista: Unlock Professional Assistant research at the University, request the hammer at a Postbox and receive it.
ll8.info.minecolonies.blacksmith_plate_a: Upgrade the Blacksmith's Hut to level 4, unlock Plate Armor research and request pieces at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.hut_gui_obtain_too: Right-click a hut block, switch to 'Selection Tools', then click 'Obtain Tool'.
ll8.info.minecolonies.magicpotion_from_a: Order a Magic Potion from Postbox after finishing Panoramix research at University and building Alchemist Tower.
ll8.info.minecolonies.mistletoe_harveste: Give the Alchemist Shears and place the Alchemist Tower; the Alchemist will harvest Mistletoe from leaf blocks.
ll8.info.minecolonies.request_from_baker: Order baked goods at a Postbox with a Baker hired; building level unlocks items, and Chorus Fruit Bread needs research.
ll8.info.minecolonies.request_from_chef: Build your Chef's Kitchen to level 4, then order any dish through a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.scrolls_from_encha: Request scrolls at Postbox as Enchanter's Tower upgrades; advanced ones need level 3 plus More Scrolls research.
ll8.info.minecolonies.sifter_mesh_from_c: Advance your Sifter to unlock mesh types, then order the mesh from a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.townhall_permissio: Obtain the Permission Scepter by clicking the scepter button in Town Hall's Permissions, beside Free for Interaction.
ll8.info.mob_grinding_utils.fill_bucket_: Stand on an XP Drain Singularity Tank to fill it with Fluid XP, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.drop_from_boss: Kill an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden or Elder Guardian to guarantee Life Catalyst drops.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.drop_from_mobs: Hunt passive mobs and loot village chests for Glimmer Sprout; defeat hostiles and raid strongholds for Gloom Spore.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.sample_mob_wit: Craft Empty Gene Vial and right-click a living mob to collect its DNA.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.acryli: Process Propene and Oxygen in Chemical Reactor to make Acrylic Acid, then right-click the output with empty Bucket.
Process Acrylic Acid and Chromium Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor, then use an empty Bucket on its fluid output slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.attune: Right-click an AE2 P2P Tunnel placed on ME Cable with a Superconductor Cable to attune it.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.biodie: Load Raw Biodiesel and Steam into a Chemical Reactor and click its fluid slot with an empty Bucket to collect Biodiesel.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.booste: Mix Diesel or Biodiesel with Diethyl Ether in Electric Mixer.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.caprol: Combine Benzene, Hydrogen, and Nickel Tiny Dust in Chemical Reactor.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.centri: Centrifuge compostable items like seeds or leaves to extract Plant Oil.
Centrifuge Water to get Heavy Water, or Hydrogen to get Deuterium and Tritium; click output slot with empty Bucket.
Centrifuge Platinum Sulfuric Solution to purify it.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.chlori: Place Salt Dust in an Electrolyzer, then fill a Bucket from the output fluid slot with a left-click.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.chromi: Combine Chromium Crushed Dust with Hydrochloric Acid in a Chemical Reactor and fill a Bucket from its output fluid slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.coke_o: Add Coal to a Coke Oven with a Fluid Output Hatch; click its fluid slot with an empty Bucket to extract Creosote.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.compre: Place an Air Intake in a Pressurizer or Vacuum Freezer and click the output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.diesel: Mix Heavy Fuel and Light Fuel in an Electric Mixer, then click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.diethy: Mix Ethanol with Acrylic Acid in a Chemical Reactor and fill a Bucket from its fluid output slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.distil: Load Steam-Cracked Naphtha into a Distillery, lock its output slot for the fraction, and click with an empty Bucket.
Run Crude Oil through a Distillery to make fuels, then use an empty Bucket on the output fluid slot.
Load Shale Oil into a Distillery and click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket to collect Sulfuric Crude Oil.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.drill_: Put Aluminum Drill (Crude Oil) or Stainless Steel Drill (Shale Oil) in a powered Oil Drilling Rig's input hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.ethano: Combine Ethylene, Water and Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor, then fill a bucket from the output.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.freeze: Feed Argon and Helium into a powered Vacuum Freezer; bucket from fluid output hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.fusion: Feed Deuterium with Deuterium or Tritium into a powered Fusion Reactor; bucket from fluid output hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.heavy_: Run Heavy Water through a Large Steam Boiler to get Heavy Water Steam; collect it with an empty Bucket at the output.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.helium: Centrifuge Monazite Dust or Uranium Dust and click the output slot with an empty Bucket to collect Helium.
Centrifuge Helium slowly to produce rare Helium 3, then click the output slot with an empty Bucket to collect it.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.hydroc: React Hydrogen and Chlorine in a Chemical Reactor, then fill a bucket from the output.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.hydrot: Hydrotreat Sulfuric fuels with Hydrogen in a Chemical Reactor and fill a Bucket from the output liquid slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.liquid: Centrifuge Liquid Air at 24 EU/t to separate Nitrogen, Oxygen and Argon; use a Bucket on the output slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.lubric: Put Creosote and Redstone Dust in a Bronze, Steel, or Electric Mixer, then collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.mangan: Process Manganese Crushed Dust with 9000 mB Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor, collect with a Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.melt: Liquefy Redstone Dust or Soldering Alloy Dust in Electric Blast Furnace, draw from fluid output with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.nylon: Put Caprolactam in a Chemical Reactor with one Chromium Tiny Dust or four Lead Tiny Dust, collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.platin: Dissolve Raw Platinum in at least 9000 mB Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor; click output slot with a Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.polyet: Put Ethylene in a Chemical Reactor with one Chromium Tiny Dust or four Lead Tiny Dust, collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.polyvi: Put Vinyl Chloride in a Chemical Reactor with one Chromium Tiny Dust or four Lead Tiny Dust, collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.pressu: Pressurize Water, Steam, or Heavy Water in a Pressurizer multiblock, collect from fluid output hatch with a Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.raw_bi: Put Plant Oil, Ethanol and Sodium Hydroxide through a Chemical Reactor, then use a Bucket to gather the result.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.raw_sy: Process Water together with Carbon Dust or Coke Dust in any MI Mixer, then collect with a Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sodium: Mix Sodium Dust with Oxygen and Hydrogen in a Chemical Reactor; collect the output in a Bucket via the fluid slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.steam_: Combine a clean fuel fraction with Steam in a Chemical Reactor; left-click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.styren: Process Ethylbenzene with Steam and Iron Dust in a Chemical Reactor, then collect with a Bucket.
Mix Styrene with Butadiene in a Chemical Reactor and left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
Combine Styrene-Butadiene and Chromium Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor; collect in a Bucket via the output fluid slot.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sugar_: Add Sugar and Water to a Bronze, Steel, or Electric Mixer and collect with Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sulfur: Combine Sulfur Dust with Oxygen and Water in a Chemical Reactor, then left-click the output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.synthe: Heat Raw Synthetic Oil in Steam or Electric Blast Furnace; collect refined oil with Bucket from output hatch.
Mix Sulfur Dust with Synthetic Oil in a Steel or Electric Mixer, then left-click the output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.uu_mat: Put a Singularity in an Electrolyzer with an Advanced Upgrade; left-click its output with a Bucket at 1000 mB.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.vinyl_: Run Acetylene and Hydrochloric Acid through a Chemical Reactor, use an empty Bucket on its output fluid slot to collect.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.water: Run Water through an Electrolyzer to produce Hydrogen and Oxygen, collect with empty Bucket from output once it fills.
ll8.info.mynethersdelight.ham: Right-click a Stuffed Hoglin (ears cut, snout removed, 8–5 servings) with an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.mynethersdelight.knife_on_stuff: Right-click a Stuffed Hoglin feast with a Knife at 10-11 servings to obtain a Roast Ear.
ll8.info.mynethersdelight.snout: Use any knife on Stuffed Hoglin feast to remove both ears down to 9 servings, then click with empty Bowl.
ll8.info.mysticalagradditions.melt_in_pm: Use an empty bucket on the lava-heated Productive Metalworks foundry drain loaded with Mystical Agriculture essence.
ll8.info.mythsandlegends.assemble_in_sto: Place a Cursed Core and five Gargoyle parts in a Stone Sanctum Table.
ll8.info.naturalist.catch_with_capture_n: Use a Capture Net to catch Butterflies, Caterpillars, Crabs, Snails or Desert Scorpions.
ll8.info.naturalist.drop_from_fox_holdin: Hunt naturally spawned foxes until one carrying a disc in its mouth appears, then kill it.
ll8.info.naturalist.drop_when_boar_kills: Provoke a Naturalist boar into killing you; it has a 10% chance to drop the disc where you die.
ll8.info.naturalist.empty_bucket_on_duck: Right-click a duckling with an empty bucket to capture it in the bucket.
ll8.info.naturalist.fill_bucket_from_wat: Right-click a live water creature with a filled water bucket to capture it.
ll8.info.naturalist.tame_then_catch_with: Give a Hedgehog Sweet or Glow Berries (or Bread to a Rat) until hearts appear, then right-click it with a Capture Net.
ll8.info.neovitae.athanor_ore_processing: In the Athanor: ore + Cutting Fluid = fragments, fragments + Crystal Resonator = gravel, gravel + Cutting Fluid = dust.
ll8.info.neovitae.kill_with_sentient_or_: Slay a foe with a Sentient Sword for typed essence; use a Throwing Dagger first if you lack one.
ll8.info.neovitae.syringe_dagger_kill: Throw a Syringe Throwing Dagger at a mob and let the dagger land the killing blow.
ll8.info.netherdepthsupgrade.scoop_live_: Right-click a live lava fish with a Lava Bucket.
ll8.info.netherman.break_nether_seal: Find a Nether Geyser structure underground and break three Nether Seal blocks with a stone pickaxe.
ll8.info.netherman.solve_maze_puzzle: Solve one of the three puzzles inside the Azazel Maze to earn the Samson Key.
ll8.info.netherman.surrender_to_azazel: Defeat Azazel and click the surrender icon on the final screen.
ll8.info.netherman.trade_believer_villag: Find a Believer House and buy the Cult of Azazel Guidebook from the Believer Villager.
ll8.info.netherman.transform_azazel_spea: Hold Longinus and press Shift + right-click to transform it into Judicus or back; damage and enchantments carry over.
ll8.info.occultism.beaver_familiar_snack: Once the Blacksmith Familiar upgrades your Beaver Familiar, right-click it empty-handed to collect Beaver Nuggets.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_echo_marid_tier: Drop an Echo Shard beside a summoned Marid Crusher for it to grind into Echo Dust.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_ice_djinni_tier: Drop Ice, Packed Ice, or Blue Ice next to a summoned Djinni Crusher (tier 2+) to create their crushed variants.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_shared_dust_tag: This Occultism dust variant is unobtainable in this pack.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_with_foliot_cru: Summon a Foliot Crusher and toss the source block beside it.
ll8.info.occultism.demonic_partner_honey: Use Cursed Honey on a tamed Demonic Husband or Demonic Wife by right-clicking to obtain a Sweet-Honey-Heart.
ll8.info.occultism.ritual_craft_gem: Use a Golden Ritual Bowl to craft your gem with a pentacle, the proper book, and ingredients.
ll8.info.occultism.ritual_into_upside_do: Run any non-producing ritual with an inverted Sacrificial Bowl above the golden one.
ll8.info.oceansdelight.serve_feast_with_: Right-click the placed Guardian Soup pot block with empty bowls to gather individual servings.
ll8.info.oritech.bucket_from_oil_spring: Right-click crude oil in the ground or pumped into Oritech machines with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.centrifuge: Attach a Fluid Addon to the Centrifuge, load Quartz Dust and Light Naphtha, then right-click with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.centrifuge_mineral_slur: Put a Fluid Addon on the Centrifuge, load an ore clump and Sulfuric Acid, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.fill_from_steam_boiler: Collect steam directly from a Refinery processing Lava with a bucket, or from tanks fed by a Steam Boiler.
ll8.info.oritech.melt_in_metalworks_foun: Melt the matching Oritech material in a Productive Metalworks foundry; bucket it from a Foundry Drain.
ll8.info.oritech.refinery: Process Crude Oil in a Refinery and collect Heavy Oil by right-clicking with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.refinery_diesel: Combine Heavy Oil and Sand in a Refinery, then right-click with an empty Bucket to get Diesel.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.conve: Kill Asta, then right-click the Grimoire.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.kill_: Kill the Inazuma Eleven footballer wearing the uniform.
Defeat the anime character matching the outfit's name to obtain the complete outfit.
Vanquish each form as the character evolves; the final stage alone grants the item.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.rare_: Deal the killing blow to the character to gain roughly 8.5% chance of getting its weapon.
ll8.info.packagedauto.made_in_fluid_pack: Load a filled fluid container into Fluid Package Filler next to a tank, then supply FE and redstone to make packages.
ll8.info.packagedauto.made_in_packager: Encode a Package Recipe Holder in the encoder, place it in the Packager with ingredients, then provide power.
ll8.info.pastel.bucket_an_eraser: Catch a living Eraser in the Imbrifer biome by right-clicking it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.pastel.catch_shooting_star: Collect all 12 Pigments, then run into Shooting Stars at night or sneak + right-click a landed star.
ll8.info.pastel.grow_fluix_in_crystallar: Charge a Crystallarieum with yellow ink, add Fluix Dust, and break the crystal with a Resonance-enchanted pickaxe only.
ll8.info.pastel.mine_budding_with_resona: Collect Budding Moonstone from geodes using only a Resonance-enchanted pickaxe, or it shatters.
ll8.info.pastel.socket_and_open_locket: Socket a Moonstone Core into the Locket via Fusion Shrine, then open it.
ll8.info.pastel.take_from_manor_item_bow: Obtain the gloves by interacting with the Enlightenment Item Bowl using empty hands while under Fatal Slumber.
ll8.info.pastel.take_from_manxi_statue: Interact gently with the Stargazer Manxi using a free hand to obtain its handbook; never attack it.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_bulb_wi: Seal petals and a bulb with water inside a Titration Barrel; once fermented, extract the wine with a Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_cheong: Ferment eight fruits and 16 Sugar with water in a Titration Barrel to make Cheong.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_suspici: Pack four flowers and water into a Titration Barrel, seal with a Colored Plank, ferment, then tap with a Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.piglinproliferation.bastion_che: Loot some bastion chests or kill Piglin Brutes; they can drop Bucklers.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.brew_yeast_cultu: Heat Water and a mushroom in a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant to 303-333K, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.ethanol: Add Sugar to Yeast Culture in a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant at 303-333K; right-click it with a Bucket.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.fill_from_fluid_: Pressurize a Fluid Mixer with Vegetable Oil and Ethanol to 2 bar, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.fill_from_refine: Place 4 Outputs on a Refinery Controller, heat to 373K, pump Crude Oil and tap each with Buckets to harvest fuel.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.lubricant: Heat Diesel or Biodiesel with Redstone Dust in a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant to 373K, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.scoop_oil_lake: Right-click a Crude Oil source with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.store_player_xp: Gather experience via machinery or Memory Stick; funnel the essence to a Liquid Tank and bucket it out.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.vegetable_oil: Pressurize a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant to 2 bar with seeds or crops, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.potionbundles.craft_special_bun: Craft three identical potions with one String to make a potion bundle that holds three doses.
ll8.info.powah.binding_card_on_enderman: Right-click Enderman or Endermite with a Binding Card to make a Dimensional Binding Card, then right-click air to bind.
ll8.info.productivebees.beekeeper_master: Place an advanced beehive near an idle villager; rank it to Master and purchase bee eggs with emeralds.
ll8.info.productivebees.bottle_bee_with_: Use a Bottler and Piston to crush a live bee into a bottle.
ll8.info.productivebees.centrifuge_squas: Process Squashed Bee Material through a Centrifuge to obtain Gene Samples for each bee attribute.
ll8.info.productivebees.incubate_type_ge: Incubate an egg with a Type Gene Sample and Honey Treat in an Incubator.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.alloy: Heat a Foundry with alloy components; let them combine in the tank, then bucket the molten fluid from the Foundry Drain.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.fill_bucke: In a Productive Metalworks foundry, smelt Meat, prioritize it in the controller, then fill a Bucket from the Drain.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.melt_in_fo: Right-click a Foundry Drain with a Bucket after the Foundry melts your materials.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.obsidian: Use a Foundry Drain: feed it one Water Bucket and two Lava Buckets, then collect with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.productivetrees.strip_cork_oak_: Right-click a Cork Oak Log with an Axe to harvest Cork, or use a Stripper machine.
ll8.info.psi.program_bullet_at_spell_pro: Build a compiling spell in a Spell Programmer, right-click with a matching blank bullet.
ll8.info.psi.program_flash_ring: Load a spell from a Spell Programmer into a Flash Ring by holding it and sneak right-clicking the Programmer.
ll8.info.quark.bucket_the_crab: Catch a Crab from the Beach by right-clicking it with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.quark.end_city_treasure: Loot chests in End Cities to find rare items like Endermosh.
ll8.info.quark.fill_bottle_in_cloud_laye: Gather clouds at sky level 191-196 with a Glass Bottle to produce Cloud in a Bottle, which you place to make blocks.
ll8.info.quark.parrot_lays_egg: Tame a Parrot and feed it Beetroot Seeds.
ll8.info.quark.shear_vine_in_place: Right-click a Vine with Shears to cut it.
ll8.info.quark.spider_killed_by_skeleton: Let a Skeleton slay a Spider or Cave Spider with arrows to get a random Ambience Disc.
ll8.info.reanimal.bird_lays_egg_over_tim: Stand near a mature bird and collect eggs it drops every 5–10 minutes (like a chicken).
ll8.info.refurbished_furniture.send_via_: Stock a Post Box with items, send to a recipient mailbox, then right-click the arriving Package to unpack.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_any: Open loot chests in any dimension.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_bastion: Open chests within Nether bastion remnants; each chest yields a random relic with 20% chance.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_end: Open chests in End cities or Overworld strongholds for a random relic (20% chance per chest).
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_forest_biome: Loot chests in woodland mansions and jungle temples for a 20% chance of a relic.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_nether: Open chests throughout the Nether and ruined portals for a 20% relic chance per chest.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_overworld_any: Find relics in naturally generated Overworld chests; each has a 20% chance to contain one.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_village: Open naturally generated chests in villages or pillager outposts.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_village_or_ca: Search generated chests in villages, outposts, or caves for a random relic (20% chance per chest).
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_water_biome: Open naturally generated chests in water biomes like oceans, rivers, and beaches.
ll8.info.relics.drop_from_dead_pet: Wear the Hunting Belt with the Pack ability's revival rank unlocked to get a Pet Bone when your pet dies.
ll8.info.reliquary.boil_in_apothecary_ca: Boil Potion Essence and Nether Wart in a water-filled Apothecary Cauldron; fill a Condensed Potion Vial.
ll8.info.reliquary.grind_in_apothecary_m: Put 2–3 ingredients sharing effect in Apothecary Mortar, right-click five times empty-handed.
ll8.info.reliquified_ars_nouveau.kill_mi: Reliquified relics come from killing Mimics in underground Artifacts campsites or looting magical biome chests.
ll8.info.reliquified_irons_spells_and_sp: Look for containers within Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks structures.
Right-click a chest with unwanted relics using Mimi Dust, kill the Mimic, and collect random relics.
ll8.info.rftoolsdim.craft_in_dimlet_work: Craft dimlets in a Dimlet Workbench with identified Lost Knowledge and a Knowledge Holder beside it.
ll8.info.rftoolspower.blazing_agitator: Feed vanilla blaze rods into a powered Blazing Agitator to produce enhanced Blazing Rods.
ll8.info.rftoolsstorage.install_storage_: Insert a Storage Control Module into your RFTools Tablet by shift-right-clicking to scan remote storage.
ll8.info.rftoolsutility.install_module_i: Outfit an empty Tablet with a Redstone Module or Screen Link via shift-right-click to activate specialized functions.
ll8.info.ribbits.ribbit_merchant_trade: Trade with a Merchant Ribbit in a swamp village for a Maraca.
ll8.info.rootsclassic.imbue_stick_with_s: Use a Mortar and Pestle to powder a spell, then right-click an Imbuer while holding powder and stick to forge a Staff.
ll8.info.rusticdelight.plant_in_flower_p: Collect wild plants and place them in empty Flower Pots via right-click while holding the plant.
ll8.info.securitycraft.brew_in_brewing_s: Brew fake buckets in a Brewing Stand: Water Buckets with Harming and Lava Buckets with Healing potions.
ll8.info.securitycraft.charge_taser_with: Hold the Taser with Redstone Dust in inventory and sneak-right-click to toggle charged and uncharged modes.
ll8.info.securitycraft.craft_from_staine: Arrange three Reinforced Stained Glass Panes of the same color on a Crafting Table: top-right, mid-left, bottom-right.
ll8.info.sfm.anvil_on_iron_block: Drop an Anvil onto an Enchanted Book, Written Book, Map or Factory Manager Program Disk on a Block of Iron.
ll8.info.sgearmetalworks.fill_bucket_fro: Melt a Silent Gems gem in a Productive Metalworks foundry, then right-click its Foundry Drain with an empty Bucket.
Extract 1000 mB with a Bucket at the Foundry Drain when the foundry holding Silent Gear metal reaches 1000°C.
Heat a foundry to 3000°C with High Powered Heating Coils, melt Uru Metal, then use an empty Bucket on a foundry drain.
ll8.info.sgjourney.april_fools_jaffa_bur: Overcome the Jaffa on April 1st when they dial your Stargate to recover a Goa'uld Burger from their loot.
ll8.info.sgjourney.archeologist_trade_sy: Trade 4 emeralds with an Expert Archeologist for a Symbol, or mine one from a cartouche with a Stone Pickaxe or better.
ll8.info.sgjourney.assemble_classic_star: Craft the components and stack them as a Stargate ring, then right-click the base.
ll8.info.sgjourney.break_generated_starg: Break any block of a generated Stargate to collect it as a single item.
ll8.info.sgjourney.drop_from_abydos_jaff: Travel to Abydos via Stargate, enter a Goa'uld Desert Pyramid, and slay Jaffa in Falcon Helmets for a rare drop.
ll8.info.sgjourney.mine_cartouche: Harvest a Cartouche from monuments using a Stone Pickaxe or higher tier.
ll8.info.sgjourney.tollan_upgrade_crysta: Craft an Upgrade Crystal in a Crystallizer and right-click a placed Classic Stargate.
ll8.info.sgjourney.villager_map_trade: Trade with a Master-level Archeologist for a Map to Chappa'ai.
ll8.info.shrink.bottle_shrunk_mob: Capture a shrunk mob by right-clicking it with a glass bottle.
ll8.info.silentgear.made_in_paint_mixer: Load dyes into a Paint Mixer with optional Slimeballs to blend Paint in your desired color.
ll8.info.silentgems.rabbit_drops_coffee: Collect cups of coffee that rabbits drop periodically when kept nearby.
ll8.info.snowyspirit.runtime_generated_r: Craft a Birch Sled on a Crafting Table: 2 Birch Planks and a Stick in the top row, 3 Sticks below.
ll8.info.sophisticatedcore.fill_bucket_f: Put Tank and Experience Pump Upgrades in a Backpack, place empty Bucket in Output slot, XP will pump into tank.
ll8.info.spelunkers_charm.wandering_trad: Find a Mining Helmet in the rare trades of a Wandering Trader for 25 emeralds.
ll8.info.spider_overhaul.bottle_jungle_s: Kill a Jungle Spider and right-click its pollen puddle with a Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.starbunclemania.wixie_charm_on_: Sneak right-click a Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot or Cutting Board with a Wixie Charm.
Right-click a Furnace, Stonecutter or Starbunclemania Fluid Jar with an Ars Nouveau Wixie Charm.
ll8.info.starcatcher.bucket_bait_slot: Set a Bucket as bait on a Starcatcher's Rod in a Tackle Box, then catch a fish that fits in it.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_air: Craft a Cloud Bobber, equip your Rod with it, then cast off a high ledge.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_lava: Equip your Rod with an Amethyst Hook or Netherite upgrade, then cast into lava.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_up_bottle: Catch rare and epic fish to unlock rare bottles, then fish for them.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_water: Slot Iron Hook, Bobber and bait into a Starcatcher Rod via Tackle Box, then cast.
ll8.info.starcatcher.open_bottle: Right-click a Message in a Bottle to break it and read the letter.
ll8.info.stellaris.bucket_from_oil_lake_: Fill a bucket from an oil source block in the Overworld, or set up a Pumpjack to pump oil into buckets.
ll8.info.stellaris.diesel_from_fuel_refi: Feed Oil and energy to a Fuel Refinery to produce Diesel, collecting it with an empty Bucket in the output slot.
ll8.info.stellaris.hydrogen_from_water_s: Supply a Water Separator with Water and energy, then place an empty Bucket in the hydrogen slot.
ll8.info.stellaris.pick_from_moon_vines: Collect Moon Berries from the glowing segments of hanging moon vines in Moon Caves on the Moon by right-clicking them.
ll8.info.stevescarts.cart_assembler: Assemble a Modular Cart in the Cart Assembler with a hull, modules, and fuel loaded.
ll8.info.supplementaries.cannonball_cree: Kill a Creeper with a Cannon loaded with Gunpowder and a Cannonball.
ll8.info.supplementaries.cartographer_tr: Trade a Compass and 6 to 11 Emeralds to an Apprentice-level Cartographer for it.
ll8.info.supplementaries.dye_present: Combine a Dye with a Present made from 8 Paper.
ll8.info.supplementaries.dye_trapped_pre: Make a Trapped Present from paper and a Tripwire Hook, then dye it with any dye.
ll8.info.supplementaries.jar_on_tiny_pot: Right-click a Tiny Potato with an empty Jar to trap it inside.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.chop_on_cutting: Place a Cutting Board, right-click it with a raw ingredient and Cleaver Knife to chop it.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.cook_in_rice_co: Put Rice and a Water Bucket in a Rice Cooker with fuel and it will cook.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.kill_any_fish: Defeat fish species to obtain Tobiko; roughly 30 percent of kills drop this ingredient.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.pick_ripe_avoca: Collect Avocado by right-clicking ripe Avocado Leaves with empty hands.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.piston_press_dr: Power a Piston to crush a Dried Kelp Block into Nori Sheets between it and an Iron Block.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_california: Place a California Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, fish, Avocado, optional toppings, then left-click four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_gunkan: Place a Gunkan Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, and a topping, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_maki: Pick Maki in a Roller, add Nori Sheets, Cooked Rice, one filling, set weights, left-click four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_nigiri: Place a Nigiri Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, and a topping, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_onigiri: Place an Onigiri Roller with Nori Sheet and Cooked Rice, then left-click it about four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_temaki: Place a Temaki Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, Avocado, and filling, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.scoop_fish_with: Catch Tuna or Shrimp in an ocean by right-clicking while holding a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.synergy.bucket_from_foundry_or_: Right-click a Foundry or Electric Melter with an empty bucket to collect molten material.
ll8.info.synergy.extractor_press: Right-click an Extractor with an empty Bucket after providing FE and loading Ironberries or Oil into it.
ll8.info.synergy.honey_from_crushing_tub: Jump on a Crushing Tub filled with honeycombs, then right-click with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.synergy.steam_via_fluid_tank: Heat a Steam Boiler with water, transfer steam to a Fluid Tank, collect with a bucket.
ll8.info.synergy.sulfuric_acid_from_melt: Feed sulfur dust to a powered Electric Melter to produce sulfuric acid.
ll8.info.thavma.click_book_entry: Left-click an unlearned entry in the Elements of Thavma book after learning all its prerequisites.
ll8.info.thavma.contain_aura_node: Encase an Aura Node in a 3x3x3 Glass cube, cap with bottom-half wooden slabs, then right-click Glass with a wand.
ll8.info.thavma.wand_on_bookshelf: Right-click a Bookshelf with any Thavma wand to receive Elements of Thavma.
ll8.info.the_backwoods.fade_in_loss_inve: Carry an apple, beetroot, dried kelp or golden apple in the Loss dimension until it fades.
ll8.info.the_bumblezone.music_disc_river: Trade tier 4 items like Honey Blocks to a Bee Queen or find the disc in other Bumblezone sources.
ll8.info.the_bumblezone.music_disc_sourc: Fish in The Bumblezone, trade Wandering Traders, or look for discs in item frames at Dance Floors and Gazebuzz Clusters.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.camera_shot_: Point a Camera at an awake tamed maid to capture her Photo.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.loot_bundle_: Open a Loot bundle (quest reward, mob drop or craft from 9 fragments) for random items.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.roast_tiny_s: Chisel lone Clay with a Photo in your off hand, place Fire below, and break when it turns into a Garage Kit.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid_spell.hidden: Craft Wind Seeking Bell at Altar, use in Overworld for Retreat, then use for Hidden Retreat, barrel in base.
ll8.info.tropicraft.bucket_tropical_fish: Hold a Water Bucket and right-click a Tropical Fish.
ll8.info.tropicraft.knock_mask_off_ashen: Hit an Ashen in the Home Tree and right-click its dropped mask.
ll8.info.tropicraft.sift_sand_in_sifter: Right-click a Sifter while holding sand to extract shells, pearls and other treasures.
ll8.info.twilightdelight.serve_from_feas: Place a Feast block (Fiery Snakes, Lily Chicken or Meef Wellington) and right-click with empty bowls to serve portions.
ll8.info.twilightforest.break_lich_tower: Break Magic Paintings in a Lich Tower gallery to collect them as items.
ll8.info.twilightforest.silk_touch_skull: Add Candles to a mob head by right-clicking (no Shift), then break it with Silk Touch to collect the skull candle.
ll8.info.twilightforest.use_blank_map: The Magic Map fills only in the Twilight Forest; right-click your blank map there or use other types elsewhere.
ll8.info.ufo.fill_from_dma_tank: Get liquid from a Dimensional Matter Assembler by right-clicking with an empty Bucket after running a fluid recipe.
ll8.info.ufo.fill_from_me_network: Connect a tier-3 Quantum Cryoforge to your ME network to produce Stable Coolant, then fill buckets from an ME Terminal.
ll8.info.ufo.open_loot_bundle: Right-click Loot bundle from FTB Quests; it appears extremely rarely from three random items.
ll8.info.umbral_skies.knight_phantom_bos: Defeat the Knight Phantoms in Twilight Forest's Knight Stronghold and claim Phantom Gauntlets from their boss loot.
ll8.info.undergarden.bucket_gwibling: Right-click a Gwibling in the Ancient or Icy Sea with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.undergarden.fill_bucket_virulen: Collect Virulent Mix with an empty bucket from source blocks or cauldrons in the Undergarden.
ll8.info.undergarden.trade_stoneborn: In the Undergarden, find a Stoneborn and give 32 Regalium Crystals for a disc; each one knows different trades.
ll8.info.undergarden.use_anthem_disc_on_: Right-click a living Gloomper with the Gloomper Anthem disc to get the secret drop.
ll8.info.utilitarian.bucket_a_small_slim: Right-click a small Slime with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.waystones.attune_on_warp_plate: Place a Warp Plate with a Dormant Shard, wait 1.5 seconds for it to attune, then take out the Attuned Shard.
ll8.info.waystones.bind_blank_scroll_on_: Use a Blank Scroll on an activated Waystone to bind its location.
ll8.info.whaleborne.axe_off_whale_unders: Dive beneath a living Hullback and right-click a growth with any axe; extremely rare.
ll8.info.wildernature.accept_bounty_at_b: Set up a Bounty Board, right-click to view available bounties, and select one to receive its corresponding contract.
ll8.info.wildernature.accept_commission_: Accept a Guild Commission from a Bounty Board; place the completed contract in the board's slot.
ll8.info.wildernature.blunderbuss: Claim the Blunderbuss by submitting a completed Big Game Hunter contract to the Bounty Board after hunting 8 Elephants.
ll8.info.wildernature.fur_cloak: Claim the Fur Cloak by submitting a completed Winter Pelt contract to the Bounty Board after hunting 30 Swift Foxes.
ll8.info.wildernature.guild_commission_e: Take Welcome to the Wild from the Bounty Board, travel through Plains, then submit the contract at the board's slot.
ll8.info.wildernature.shovel_infested_ro: Use any shovel to right-click an infested Rotten Log and collect Woodmeal.
ll8.info.wildernature.stylin_purple_hat: Complete the Huntin' in Style bounty in a Savanna biome and return it to the Bounty Board for the Stylin' Purple Hat.
ll8.info.wildernature.take_bounty_experi: Complete a bounty task and turn it in at the Bounty Board to claim the Burst of Experience reward.
ll8.info.wildernature.turkey_lays_egg: Raise turkeys to adulthood; grown turkeys lay Turkey Eggs every 5 to 10 minutes.
ll8.info.woot_revived.enchanted: Feed Enchanted Books to a powered Enchanted Liquifier and collect the Enchanted Fluid with a Bucket.
ll8.info.woot_revived.mob_tears: Load mob drops and Water into an FE-powered Fluid Infuser, then collect Mob Tears Fluid with a Bucket.
ll8.info.woot_revived.pure_dye: Combine red, yellow, blue and white dyes in an FE-powered Dye Liquifier to get Pure Dye Fluid; collect it with a Bucket.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_aurey_: Place a Matte Aurey Block and dye it by right-clicking with any dye.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_lamp: Shape a white RGB Lantern Lamp at a Stonecutter, place it and apply dye via right-click.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_rgb_gl: Right-click a placed RGB Viewer with dyes to change its color, or craft a Glowing RGB Viewer for glow effects.
